sampling_rule: Prospectively fixed one group per new source case before any new-case answer; all six anonymous candidates in each selected group. Covers both rental turns across cases and both retrieval lengths. This is a36-answer source audit, not an independent rescore of all108 answers.
blinding: Reviewers see source truth, actual evidence views, rubric and anonymous final answers; no arm names, cost, primary judge output or generator status. Representation treatment may be inferable from evidence format. Reviewers do not author their reviewed fixtures.
additional_review: Inspect all deterministic mismatches and primary material-error annotations separately as targeted post-hoc checks; label targeted selection and root unblinding explicitly.
cost_scope: Parent/subagent source review is outside measured CLI usage; no additional benchmark model calls.
